name: Synthetix sKRW oracle incident June2019
summary: The protocol blog describes a faulty commercial KRW feed and an earlier feed outage that left two inputs; their average produced an incorrect rate. A trading bot profited before service interruption, and the protocol reports an agreement to reverse the trades. This is an off-chain oracle incident lead, not an established Solidity defect.
browser_observation: Reddit post by the protocol account linked the official blog; both pages were opened. The blog title, publication date and incident description were visible.
scope: conditional / off-chain oracle reliability; exclude from source-code-defect examples unless an on-chain violated invariant is independently demonstrated
gaps: No attack transaction hash, historical source, realized loss or earliest UTC incident timestamp established.
Reported notional trading profits are not proven realized theft.
Not eligible as a Solidity vulnerability positive on this evidence.
